Package com.composum.sling.platform.staging.query

Class Query

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.composum.sling.platform.staging.query.Query
  • Direct Known Subclasses:
    StagingQueryImpl
    public abstract class Query
extends Object
    Allows querying resources with a fluent API , transparently supporting querying the released versions of resources when used on a StagingResourceResolver. Create this with QueryBuilder.makeQuery(ResourceResolver).

    For better overview, this class contains just the builder-specific stuff - the actual SQL statements are created and executed in the implementation.

    Author:
    Hans-Peter Stoerr

        Mandatory absolute path below which we query descendant resources. As with SQL2 ISDESCENDANTNODE or XPATH /somewhere//* this finds only descendants, not the node at path itself.

      • conditionBuilder

        public QueryConditionDsl.QueryConditionBuilder conditionBuilder()
        Returns a builder that can be used to create the condition for condition(QueryConditionDsl.QueryCondition). The created condition is reuseable independently of this Query (but not unmodifiable), and has an effect on the Query only when you call condition(QueryConditionDsl.QueryCondition) with it.
        See Also:
        QueryConditionDsl.builder()

      • join

        public Query join​(Query.JoinType type,
                  Query.JoinCondition joinCondition,
                  String exactPrimaryType,
                  QueryConditionDsl.QueryCondition joinSelectCondition)
        Sets a condition that restricts the found nodes via a join. There are only joins from the found nodes to children or descendants of the found node supported.

        Caution: when specifying a exactPrimaryType, this needs to match exactly the jcr:primaryType of the joined nodes. Subtypes or nodes with this as a mixin cannot be supported with sensible cost on releases (that is, frozen nodes), and cannot easily be filtered afterwards from the result set since it would be difficult to keep the semantics of outer joins.

        Parameters:
        type - the type of join
        joinCondition - the join condition: join on descendants or children
        exactPrimaryType - optional, the exact primary type of the joined nodes. Subtypes / mixins will not be found - please leave empty if there are various types possible.
        joinSelectCondition - the join select condition created with joinConditionBuilder() - once for each join
        Returns:
        this for chaining calls in builder-style
